d:
Alan and Madison are brother and sister, both students on the same campus. He’s in engineering, she’s in economics. Nothing out of the ordinary: they run into each other often, share a group of friends, and student parties are just part of the routine. A straightforward, easygoing life where everything falls into place.

But one night, during a student party, a chance encounter shatters the fragile balance of that normality.

Rebecah—beautiful, wealthy, provocative… The vibe clicks, laughter erupts, alcohol loosens things up. And suddenly, a single sentence cuts through the lightness: Rebecah confesses outright that she dreams of a threesome… with them.

When she finds out they’re siblings, her interest doesn’t wane. On the contrary—it sharpens. Mesmerized, unsettled, she makes them an indecent proposal: to pay them just for the sight of what she envisions between them.

They end up giving in—a simple kiss, in exchange for a sum too large to ignore.

From there, everything spirals—messages, threats, videos.

Under her grip, Alan and Madison slip, gradually, into a game where every move turns into another debt to settle.
